title: TFC Auto Forging with Whitelist
description: Enhanced TFC auto-forging with tap-to-activate mode, item whitelist, and configurable speed — stop over-forging the wrong tools.
body:
## What is this?

A client-side mod that enhances TFC's auto-forging with smarter controls. Based on [Eternal130's original](https://github.com/Eternal130/TFCAutoForging).

The problem: vanilla auto-forging blindly forges whatever recipe pops up — great for bulk ingots, frustrating when you wanted a pickaxe head but it remembered last session's axe head.

## Features

- **Tap-to-Activate Mode** — a middle ground between OFF and FULL AUTO. The mod waits for you to strike the first step manually, then takes over.
- **Target Item Whitelist** — configure which recipes get what policy. Whitelisted items (e.g. wrought iron blooms) can be set to full auto, while everything else requires a tap.
- **Forging Speed Control** — Extreme / Fast / Moderate / Safe, choose your pace.
- **In-game Settings Panel** (Ctrl+F) — view your backpack, right-click items to add to the whitelist, toggle policies and speed instantly. All changes save immediately.
- **Forging Tip Highlight** — animated marker on the recommended anvil button.

## Key Bindings

| Key | Function |
|-----|----------|
| F | Toggle auto-forging |
| Ctrl+F | Open settings panel |
| G | Toggle forging tip |

## Compatibility

| MC Version | JAR | Requires |
|-----------|-----|----------|
| 1.21.1 | `tfcafww-tfctng-1.21.1-0.3.jar` | NeoForge 21.1 + TFC TNG |
| 1.20.1 | `tfcafww-tfctng-1.20.1-0.3.jar` | Forge 47.x + TFC TNG 3.x |

**Client-only** — servers don't need this mod.

## Credits

Original mod by Eternal130. Whitelist, tap mode, speed control, and GUI redesign by SaloninusBlue.
